findings.statement: The write boundary claims sole-writer authority but the mapping keeps the backfill script writing job rows directly, so durability has two writers during migration.
findings.recommendation: Route backfill through the store bulk command before claiming sole-writer parity.

findings.statement: Receipt replay semantics are conditional but no experiment bounds them.
findings.recommendation: Name the receipt-replay experiment in slice S2.

steelman.strongest_support: One writable owner makes the job-state invariant enforceable by construction instead of by convention across four call sites.
steelman.strongest_opposition: The store adds a formality layer before any real second consumer exists.
